layouts.name: Estering Combo
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Estering Standard Course, Estering Joker Lap. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Estering Standard Course
layouts.description: The operator general circuit plan identifies the outer northern course through the right-angle return before the finish. This follows the closed independent main raceway; the source lap measures 928.7 m. Paddock access and the sports-centre perimeter polygon are excluded.

layouts.name: Estering Joker Lap
layouts.description: The operator plan names the Joker branch inside the northern final complex. Independently named OSM Joker way 282853377 reconnects exact source nodes to the main raceway. The source lap measures 905.4 m; no paddock or venue perimeter edges are included.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The aggregate configuration combines the independently identified Standard and Joker laps from the operator general circuit plan. The Joker branch is independently named in the source. Shared raceway edges count once, and the two closed component paths remain separate. The paddock start lane and venue perimeter polygon are excluded. The independent unique branch distance is 1062.7 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
